name: BMW R100 airheads
engine: 980 cc air-cooled boxer twin, two Bing carbs, shaft drive
intro: The big airheads. Charging system care and a timing chain check cover most of the risks.

add.title: Check the charging system
add.instructions: Measure battery voltage at full output; it should be at least 13.2 V. Check the diode board solder joints and replace its rubber mounts and ground wires when you have it out.
add.reason: High resistance in the charging circuit wastes power as heat and kills batteries.

add.title: Listen for timing chain noise
add.instructions: Listen at the front of the engine for clatter. A worn tensioner is cheap and easy to replace.
add.reason: A worn timing chain tensioner causes clatter and chain wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Charging
known.what: Excess resistance in the charging circuit is a common cause of a flat battery.
